quest.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III
quest.description: According to Smiley Yanxiao, you should be fine no matter how tricky the customer. But it seems that his every such utterance tempts fate...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x45, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Recipe: Humbly Enough x1

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: #Morning {NICKNAME}. Time to fire up the stove for another day of customers. Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With days of experience now under your belt, the work is becoming second nature...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Great work... You're looking more like a head chef every day! Hehe, whatever crazy characters come walking through that door, I know you'll be able to handle them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, no! Every time you say something like that, you jinx it!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hey, that's not true! Anyway, I didn't mean it like that...
Ahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Dude! What up, bro!? I didn't know you were in Liyue too! Ah, it's always nice to run into a broad Inazuman fellow... Wait, did I say that right?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Almost. I think you meant "fellow Inazuman abroad," Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah, that's the one! We gotta look out for each other when we're this far from home! Don't we, Ayato?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Bull-Chucker! What are you doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh hey, Flying Lavender Melon... uh, of the "Skycleaving White Iron" variety! And my compadre, too! All my buddies in one place, today's my lucky day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't you say you were gonna knuckle down and earn some Mora when you got home? How come you're back in Liyue so soon?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Haha, that can wait. As soon as I announce that Arataki Itto is available for hire, they'll be throwing Mora at me... Right now, I got a more urgent situation to attend to: I'm in the mood for some good, spicy food!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Oh, and while we're here, we were also gonna see if Grandmaster Hanakado's okay, and whatnot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The look on Shinobu's face seems to say... "Don't ask.")

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what about you, Ayato?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: ...Not too long ago, I heard a rumor that someone was hosting an Onikabuto-fighting contest in Liyue. Naturally, I came here as soon as I could... but alas, it was too late.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What? You missed it? Aw man, what a bummer!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Quite the bummer indeed — though all is not lost. Since you're here, you'll be able to tell me all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Haha, sure thing my man! But let's catch up over some food... Where's the chef, anyway? Hey, get the chef out here — I got compadres to feed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm the chef.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, sure, me too... What!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Bull-Chucker set that one up for us really nicely. Gotta give him some credit for that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...But the main chef is another guy.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh... Haha, good one compadre, you almost got me there. Alright, well get the chef out here!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon go to the kitchen and fetch Smiley Yanxiao...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, uh... May I take your order? If you're entertaining guests, I can recommend The Palace Jewels, a Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds, or...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Boss, don't forget the budget.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, okay, um... Got anything a little more, uh... down to earth?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Down to earth...? Oh... Well, we do a mean "Humbly Enough." Real hearty dish with a ton of flavor, and we don't skimp on the portion size either. That'd be the best value for your Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Humbly Enough, huh? Sounds like my kind of grub! We'll take that — no need for anything fancy, we're all friends here!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Excellent choice, Itto — I'm no fan of culinary ostentation either. Heh... sometimes a bro just knows, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: A bro just knows... Yes, a bro just knows! Bros don't suppose, 'cause bros just knows!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this for real? ...Whatever, Paimon's leaving you guys to it.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Gotta say, your friend's quite a character... Still, Humbly Enough isn't that hard to make, so I don't think we'll have any problems with this order.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, why is it called "Humbly Enough" anyway? A hearty meat dish is a good start, but in Paimon's experience, one humble dish is never enough!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Uh, I said it was hearty, but I never said it contained meat... Don't be fooled by the appearance — it's actually just tofu made to look and taste like meat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tofu!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Tofu is made of beans, isn't it... Bull-Chucker can't eat that! Guess we'll have to get them to pick something else instead...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...What's the issue? I think I caught the word "tofu"...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Wait, what are you doing? The kitchen is staff members only... *sigh* Never mind, I'll let it slide. Ma'am, could you possibly ask your Boss to order something else instead?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Haha! No one gets my bro Ayato like I do! I hereby declare that Humbly Enough will be an everlasting symbol of our friendship, or my name ain't Arataki Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Hey! Where's our food at? Hurry up, I'm almost done recounting the epic adventures of Crimson Staff!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...As you can see, changing the order may be a little difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh brother, his whole ego is riding on this, huh... Even if we break the news to him, he'd probably rather eat the tofu than eat his words...

choices.text: We're locked in now... We gotta cook that dish...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Sounds good. I'll make sure he fills up on those... We'll just have to play the rest by ear.

choices.text: How about we throw some free appetizers in?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Looks like that's all sorted? Alright, take some time to collect yourself — the next big group is coming in.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The rest of the day passes without incident...

talks.objective: Bring the food to the waiting Inazumans

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Food's here...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oho, so this is Humbly Enough? You guys don't mess around! Love me that portion size!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Come on, compadre, grab a seat. We're all friends here, so don't hold back! I'm just gonna dig right in...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Ahem! Boss, we should respect the local customs. Here in Liyue, it's polite to let the guests eat first.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Polite? Uh... Shinobu, I thought old-timey traditions weren't your style...

choices.text: Now that I've finished in the kitchen, I'm a guest too.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Are you kidding me, compadre? ...Ohh wait, I get it. The food smells so dang good, now everyone's dying to go first! Well, guess I only got my own good taste to blame. Go on, dive in, I'll wait till last!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You, Paimon, Ayato, and Shinobu help yourselves, leaving very little "meat" behind...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: ...Hah, I see.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Finally, it's my turn! Hoohoo, I spy a big chunk of deliciousness with my name on it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, don't!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? What is it now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Okay, here goes... Anyway, so uh, Paimon forgot to tell you the really cool origin story of this dish!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Origin story? Dude, who cares where it came from — we all know where it's going! Am I right? Down the gullet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, well, umm... Skipping the origin story is like... like going traveling without a tour guide! Trust Paimon, you'll get way more out of the experience after you hear it...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Paimon makes an astute observation. Much as every tea must be appreciated on its own terms, is it not a waste of the chef's goodwill to sample a dish without hearing its tale?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: My compadre's goodwill, huh? Can't have that going to waste... Alright then, gimme the full story! I'm all ears!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's more like it! Let's start with the ingredients... Actually, no, let's start with the story of Wangshu Inn... which starts with the history of Dihua Marsh...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: #(Now's our chance, {NICKNAME}!)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Got it!)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: While Itto is distracted, you and Shinobu begin to gobble down the dish...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...Man, the tale of Dihua Marsh hits hard... People in the past had it pretty rough. Makes you appreciate what you got. "Humbly enough"... that's a good way to think about life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Darn, there's no segue to tofu from here... How'd we get so off topic? Ugh. Well, good news is there's only a little bit left!)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (But we're already... beyond stuffed...)

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Aaah! Compadre, Shinobu! Have you been eating this whole time!? Save me some dregs, why don't ya!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That's it, I'm done waiting! It's my turn to eat!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Wait! Boss, that's made of—

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: One moment, Itto. I... have a small request, if you would be so kind as to consider it.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: I left home in a hurry, and was unable to bring any of my family with me. They've all heard so much about you and are huge admirers of the Arataki Gang, so they will be devastated to learn that they missed out on this opportunity.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: However... if you were willing to let me bring the remaining portion of Humbly Enough back to them, I'm sure it will help to lift their spirits.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ehh... Yeah, I dunno...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Boss, you gotta do right by your friends. They're pretty big on that in Liyue... Besides, you did eat quite a lot of the grilled fish while we were waiting for the main course...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: ...Including mine and Ayato's.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Those were for you guys!? Ah, dang it... I got too carried away telling that story, didn't I...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, in that case... Pass my regards to your fam, bro! El Chefe, can we get the rest of this to go?

choices.text: Maybe let me dig in first?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Oil, salt, sauce, vinegar... Right, that's everything we need.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}, this year's off to a good start, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The air was getting stifling, so I made some excuses and slipped away... Anyway, thanks for taking the hint earlier. I'll fill you in later.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I never knew tofu allergy was even a thing... Okay, I'll handle the appetizers, you take care of the main event.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I can help, too. Don't worry, I'm qualified — I passed Liyue's senior culinary exam once.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Seriously, if I'd blinked I would've missed it! Crimson Staff just launched itself at Bloom Pruner and sent it flying!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: I'd expect no less of the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King himself. It sounds like a truly epoch-defining duel.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: "Count Crushmore," "Instant Kill"... I never knew there were so many elite beetle-fighters in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You didn't really come for the Onikabuto-fighting contest, did you...?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Heh, can you imagine? That would be tardiness of the most unfashionable variety. No, in truth, this trip is part-business, part-leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How come you didn't come to the Lantern Rite then?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Every visitor has their own agenda. For some, the festivities are all the more reason to visit, for others, all the more reason to avoid the crowds.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: In any case, one way or another I seem to have ended up in the right place at the right time... Now, as for the leftover tofu... yes, I'm sure Thoma will dispose of it as he sees fit.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I have to get back to the docks as soon as this meal is done...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, why did you really come to Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Well, uh... thing is...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...I can explain. Boss recently found work as a sailor, which allowed him to hitch a ride here.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: After the ship docked, he had some free time to do as he pleases. He's been using that time to hang out with Grandmaster Hanakado.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Just because he's here already! No other reason!
